about_the_game:
Line 'em up and bring the pain in this action-packed arcade game. Grab your mace of choice, bash your way through hordes of enemies, and compete for the top score on the leaderboard!

  • The Mace - This weapon forces you to navigate around enemies, thinking through each encounter in a unique way. Get into position and then yank the mace across the screen, hitting enemies in the process.

  • Unique stages - Each with their own distinct set of enemies and environmental obstacles, from the gloomy depths of the dungeon to the fiery splendor of the Mace King's palace.

  • Customizable knight - Swap between different helmets and maces, each with their own unique abilities.  Play with dozens of possible combinations and learn what best suits your playstyle!

  • Different modes - Play each level separately or combine them into one epic, extended challenge. Want to push yourself even further? Take on even more powerful monsters in hard mode, or see how long you can survive in endless mode.

  • Global leaderboards - Compete with friends and strangers as you strive to become master of the mace!

  • Original chiptune soundtrack by AlmostCosmic97
